messages:
maria_cs: Heads-up — Ironforge Logistics reached out. They want a compact multimodal parser (around 7B) to extract shipping labels, manifests, and photo OCR data for their on‑prem deployment. Requirements: PII/PHI redaction, hazmat flagging, HSM/KMS integration, and audit logging. They asked for an eval and a proposed rollout before contract renewal in ~6 weeks. Can ENG + SE triage?

dan_runtime: Thanks — can we get their infra profile (GPUs, memory) and typical sequence/image sizes? Quantized 7B looks feasible but need to confirm latency targets.

leah_se: I'll send the intake checklist to their SRE today and request 200 sample documents + a few camera photos. Also will set up an enablement deck and a 1hr runbook walkthrough.

maria_cs: They emphasized two hard constraints: hazmat detection recall >= 0.95 and redaction of PII before any logs leave customer boundary. Also want audit trails retained 90 days.

dan_runtime: HSM note: we require customer PKCS#11 endpoint details for initial test. For the model: propose two variants — q4_0 for latency-sensitive routes and q2_k for max cost savings. p95 latency target they mentioned is <120ms for text-only, photo OCR can be higher.

leah_se: Eval plan draft: 5k labeled examples (mix labels/manifests/photos). Metrics: precision/recall/F1 for entity extraction, hazmat recall, end-to-end redaction success, and p95 latency. Canary plan: 10% traffic for 1 week, watch false positive/negative rates. I'll own harness + dashboard. Example eval command I’ll give them:

```
# eval harness example
python eval_harness.py --model rwd-7b-q4 --data samples.jsonl --metrics recall,precision,f1,latency --out report.json
```

maria_cs: Contract/renewal impact — account is mid-sized, CS flags as "time-sensitive". If we miss the EoQ eval deadline, this becomes a renewal risk. Please keep me posted on blockers so I can escalate to AE.

dan_runtime: I'll estimate infra and cost uplift today and post numbers here. Potential blocker: if customer wants on‑prem + HSM + strict audit we may need private package + support SLA bump.

leah_se: Scheduling: intake + samples by Thu, initial eval run in 10 business days after samples, canary 1 week after successful eval. I’ll book a cross‑functional sync for Tues.

ops_bot: Checklist created: [Intake form sent] [Samples received] [HSM config] [Eval harness run] [Canary] — ping @maria_cs when each completes.

maria_cs: Great. I'll notify AE and mark renewal watch. Also capture customer feedback during enablement; we'll have a brief outro survey and a shared issue tracker.

leah_se: Got it. I'll draft the enablement slide deck and the post‑enablement feedback form.

dan_runtime: Posting resource estimate in a follow-up message (w/ GPU/memory and pricing options). Will call out any infra gaps that block timeline.

maria_cs: Thanks all — please add any risks to the thread. :thumbsup:
